title: Full Stack & Mobile App Developer Intern
description:
Roles

As a Full Stack & Mobile App Developer Intern at Manastej , you will work directly alongside our core founding engineering team in a full-time capacity with equity/ESOP opportunities.

Responsibility

• End-to-End Product Development: Design, build, and deploy scalable web and cross-platform mobile applications (iOS & Android) that power the core Manastej user experience.

• Frontend & Mobile Engineering: Translate UI/UX wireframes (Figma) into responsive, intuitive, and performant interfaces with smooth animations and seamless state management.

• Backend & API Architecture: Develop robust RESTful APIs/GraphQL endpoints, manage database schemas, implement secure authentication, and optimize server-side performance.

• Feature Ownership & Rapid Iteration: Take complete ownership of feature pipelines from concept to production—shipping clean, maintainable code and iterating quickly based on real user feedback.

• Core Team Collaboration: Participate in sprint planning, architecture discussions, and code reviews directly with the Lead Engineer and Founder to shape the technical roadmap of Manastej.

Requirements

• Hungry to Prove & Ownership-Driven: An ambitious self-starter and builder at heart who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and solves complex problems independently rather than waiting for hand-holding.

• Full Stack & Mobile Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience with modern web and mobile frameworks (such as React.js, Next.js, Node.js, React Native, or Flutter) and database systems (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Firebase).

• Product Mindset: An eye for clean UI/UX implementation, performance optimization, and building secure, user-centric digital products.

• Version Control & Workflow: Proficiency with Git/GitHub, modern deployment workflows, and collaborative agile development.

• Educational Background: Open to driven students, freshers, and self-taught developers from any stream (B.Tech/B.E., BCA, MCA, B.Sc, or any field—your GitHub profile, shipped projects, and hustle matter far more than your degree).

Skills required

• Full Stack Development

• Mobile App Development

• React Native

• Flutter

• React.js

• Node.js

• Next.js

• REST API

• MongoDB / PostgreSQL

• Git / GitHub
